svg.aria-label: TCP opens a connection with a three-way handshake and delivers bytes reliably and in order, retransmitting lost packets; UDP sends independent packets with no handshake, no ordering and no retransmission.
svg.title: TCP opens a connection with a three-way handshake and delivers bytes reliably and in order, retransmitting lost packets; UDP sends independent packets with no handshake, no ordering and no retransmission.
